description: Changes some fields of one song of the calling account's notebook. Only the fields you pass move; a field set to null erases its value. `key` is the DISPLAYED key ("G", "Am"). `playlistIds` is the complete target membership, so it is idempotent. `publish: true` puts the song on the account's public profile and requires `publishDeclaration` the first time, plus a public username; `publish: false` removes it and has no conditions. Publishing is a deliberate act by the account holder: never publish unless they asked. To rewrite lyrics, chords or structure, use jj_create_song with the song's id instead.

ifMatch.description: The `updatedAt` you last read for this object. When set, the write is refused with a conflict error if anything changed it since (another device, or the Jam Jam app). Without it, last writer wins. Use it whenever you read, decided, then write.

playlistIds.description: COMPLETE target state of playlist membership, not a delta: the song joins the playlists listed and LEAVES every other one. [] removes it from all of them. Omit to leave memberships untouched.

publish.description: true publishes on the public profile, false un-publishes. Ask the person first.

publishDeclaration.description: Rights declaration, required ONCE per object the first time it is published. "created": the account holder wrote it. "imported_no_known_restriction": a cover they know of no restriction on. "arrangement": their own arrangement. This is a statement made by the person, not by you: ask them which one applies, never pick one on their behalf.

songId.description: Stable notebook song id, as returned by jj_list_songs or jj_get_song.

name: jj_update_song
title: Change a notebook song
